  s.SESSION_LOCATION AS location,

  a.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS building_street_address,

    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,

    a.CITY AS city,

 AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_long_name,
  CAST(SUBSTRING(b.DATE_BUILT, 7, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AS built_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.MIT_ID) AS employee_count

JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION = r.BUILDING_ROOM
WHERE b.DATE_BUILT IS NOT NULL

  CAST(SUBSTRING(b.DATE_BUILT, 7, 4) AS UNSIGNED)

SELECT
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS different_courses_count

WHERE f.FLOOR REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'

LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
  SUM(COALESCE(d.FEE, 0)) AS total_fee_collected,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS num_distinct_iap_subjects_offered,
  MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS min_enrollment,
  MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment

JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c

JOIN TIME_DAY t
  ON t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR

  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT
  sp.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,

  SUM(COALESCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, 0)) AS total_enrollment,
  MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee,
  MAX(d.FEE) AS max_fee,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions_with_info,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'N' OR ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions_without_info

JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss
  ON ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY sp.SPONSOR_NAME

SELECT

  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_distinct_iap_subjects,
  MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee,

  ON t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE

  p.PERSON_EMAIL,
  p.PERSON_NAME,

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_subjects,
  SUM(COALESCE(d.FEE, 0)) AS total_fee,
  MIN(
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      CASE
        WHEN STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') < STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p')
          THEN STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p')
        ELSE STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
      END
    )
  ) AS shortest_session_length_minutes,
  MAX(
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      CASE
        WHEN STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') < STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p')
          THEN STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p')
        ELSE STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
      END
    )
  ) AS longest_session_length_minutes
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = s.SESSION_LOCATION
WHERE s.SESSION_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.SESSION_LOCATION) <> ''
GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_subjects,
  SUM(d.FEE) AS total_fee,
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
       AND s.SESSION_END_TIME IS NOT NULL
       AND STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NOT NULL
       AND STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NOT NULL
      THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(
             MINUTE,
             STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
             STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
           )
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS shortest_session_minutes,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
       AND s.SESSION_END_TIME IS NOT NULL
       AND STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NOT NULL
       AND STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NOT NULL
      THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(
             MINUTE,
             STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
             STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
           )
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS longest_session_minutes
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d

LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = s.SESSION_LOCATION
WHERE
  (
    LOWER(s.SESSION_LOCATION) LIKE '%zoom%'
    OR LOWER(s.SESSION_LOCATION) LIKE '%online%'
    OR LOWER(s.SESSION_LOCATION) LIKE '%on line%'
    OR LOWER(s.SESSION_LOCATION) LIKE '%virtual%'
    OR LOWER(s.SESSION_LOCATION) LIKE '%http%'
  )
  AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL;

SELECT
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_distinct_courses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN scd.COURSE END) AS total_degree_granting_courses
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
  ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE
GROUP BY
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL
ORDER BY
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

WITH dept_school AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sc.SCHOOL_CODE,
    sc.SCHOOL_NAME,
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
    ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
    ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
    ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = cd.COURSE
),
phone_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS DISTINCT_PHONE_NUMBERS
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
    ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
level_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS U_CNT,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS G_CNT
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
    ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  ds.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ds.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(pc.DISTINCT_PHONE_NUMBERS, 0) AS DISTINCT_PHONE_NUMBERS,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(lc.U_CNT, 0) >= COALESCE(lc.G_CNT, 0) THEN 'U'
    ELSE 'G'
  END AS MOST_COMMON_COURSE_LEVEL
FROM dept_school ds
LEFT JOIN phone_counts pc
  ON pc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN level_counts lc
  ON lc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY
  ds.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SELECT
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  sd.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key,
  scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL AS graduate_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_sis_subjects,
  MIN(ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS min_course_number,
  MAX(ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS max_course_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments
FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.DLC_KEY,
  scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL
ORDER BY
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.DLC_KEY,
  scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL;

SELECT
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT AS building_component,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_room_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS total_number_of_floors,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS total_number_of_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_number_of_facility_organizations,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS total_number_of_supervisors,
    SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_number_of_supervisees
FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
    ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
    ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = su.DLC_KEY
GROUP BY
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    b.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    b.BUILDING_NAME;

WITH dlc_space AS (
  SELECT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    sd.BUILDING_KEY,
    sd.FLOOR_KEY,
    sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd
    ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
),
dlc_space_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ds.DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS total_floors,
    SUM(ds.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_facility_organizations,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT IS NULL OR TRIM(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) = '' THEN 0
          ELSE CAST(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        END) AS total_building_heights
  FROM dlc_space ds
  LEFT JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
    ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = ds.FLOOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ds.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY ds.DLC_KEY
),
dlc_supervisor_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ssu.DEPT_NAMES AS DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS total_supervisors,
    SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
  FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
  GROUP BY ssu.DEPT_NAMES
)
SELECT
  dsa.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key,
  fo.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name,
  dsa.total_floors,
  dsa.total_square_footage,
  dsa.total_facility_organizations,
  dsu.total_supervisors,
  dsu.total_supervisees,
  dsa.total_building_heights
FROM dlc_space_agg dsa
JOIN dlc_supervisor_agg dsu
  ON dsu.DLC_KEY = dsa.DLC_KEY
LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
  ON su.DLC_KEY = dsa.DLC_KEY
LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
  ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY
  dsa.DLC_KEY,
  fo.DLC_NAME,
  dsa.total_floors,
  dsa.total_square_footage,
  dsa.total_facility_organizations,
  dsu.total_supervisors,
  dsu.total_supervisees,
  dsa.total_building_heights
ORDER BY dsa.DLC_KEY;

SELECT
  tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_distinct_tip_subjects_offered,
  SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students,
  MIN(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS min_rental_new_price,
  MAX(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS max_rental_new_price
FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
  ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY
  tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
ORDER BY
  tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SELECT
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.TERM_CODE,
  s.HGN_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  e.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_PERSON_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_PERSON_EMAIL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_DIFFERENT_COURSES_OFFERED,
  AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s
  ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.MIT_ID = s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
WHERE t.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.TERM_CODE,
  s.HGN_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  e.FULL_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS
ORDER BY
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.TERM_CODE,
  s.HGN_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  e.FULL_NAME;

SELECT
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS activity_title,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  s.SESSION_TITLE AS session_title,
  s.SESSION_START_TIME AS session_start_time,
  s.SESSION_END_TIME AS session_end_time,
  sp.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_sessions
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
  ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR sp
  ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
GROUP BY
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  s.SESSION_TITLE,
  s.SESSION_START_TIME,
  s.SESSION_END_TIME,
  sp.SPONSOR_NAME;

SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE AS sis_subject_code,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AS subject_code_description,
  cd.GRADUATE_LEVEL AS graduate_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS distinct_courses_per_department
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
  ON sc.COURSE_NUMBER = cd.COURSE
ORDER BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  cd.GRADUATE_LEVEL;

SELECT
    t.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    t.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
    CASE
        WHEN t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE())
             AND COALESCE(p.IS_CURRENT_TERM, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
    END AS is_current_term,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_distinct_cis_subjects_offered
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p
    ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c
    ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
   AND (
        (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'FA' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y')
     OR (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'JA' AND c.IS_OFFERED_IAP = 'Y')
     OR (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SP' AND c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
     OR (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SU' AND c.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y')
   )
GROUP BY
    t.TERM_CODE,
    t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    CASE
        WHEN t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE())
             AND COALESCE(p.IS_CURRENT_TERM, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
    END
ORDER BY
    t.TERM_CODE;

SELECT
  TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tm.AUTHOR, ';', 1)) AS author_first_name,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_record_counts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_different_courses
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY
  TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tm.AUTHOR, ';', 1)),
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

SELECT
  tso.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number,
  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price,
  MIN(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_new_shelf_price,
  MAX(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS max_new_shelf_price,
  SUM(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_used_shelf_price,
  MIN(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_shelf_price,
  MAX(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS max_used_shelf_price,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS num_schools_offering,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_distinct_materials
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
  tso.COURSE_NUMBER,
  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
ORDER BY
  tso.COURSE_NUMBER,
  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

SELECT
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_distinct_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_distinct_subjects,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_distinct_schools,
  MAX(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(tm.YEAR), '') AS UNSIGNED)) AS most_recent_publication_year
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
GROUP BY
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
ORDER BY
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

SELECT
    at.TERM_CODE,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_tip_subject_types_offered,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS total_materials_needed,
    MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students,
    MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_schools_offering_subjects,
    COALESCE(SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT), 0) AS total_records
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
    at.TERM_CODE,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM
ORDER BY
    at.TERM_CODE;

SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS street_address,
    fba.CITY AS city,
    fba.STATE AS state,
    fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS hr_department_name,
    b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS assignable_square_footage,
    rs.total_room_square_footage,
    rs.avg_room_square_footage
FROM BUILDINGS b
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        BUILDING_KEY,
        MAX(CITY) AS CITY,
        MAX(STATE) AS STATE
    FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS
    WHERE ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) fba
    ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        r.BUILDING_KEY,
        SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_room_square_footage,
        AVG(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS avg_room_square_footage,
        MIN(r.ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS any_organization_key
    FROM FAC_ROOMS r
    GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY
) rs
    ON rs.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY = rs.any_organization_key
ORDER BY
    b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC,
    rs.total_room_square_footage DESC,
    rs.avg_room_square_footage DESC;

WITH term_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.PREREQUISITES,
    c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
),
term_totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_in_term
  FROM term_subjects
),
instructor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    FALL_INSTRUCTORS AS instructor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_taught_across_all_records
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
  WHERE FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL AND FALL_INSTRUCTORS <> ''
  GROUP BY FALL_INSTRUCTORS
)
SELECT
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  ts.SUBJECT_ID,
  ts.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  ts.PREREQUISITES,
  tt.total_subjects_in_term,
  ts.FALL_INSTRUCTORS AS instructor,
  ic.subjects_taught_across_all_records
FROM term_subjects ts
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = ts.TERM_CODE
CROSS JOIN term_totals tt
LEFT JOIN instructor_counts ic
  ON ic.instructor = ts.FALL_INSTRUCTORS
ORDER BY
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  ts.SUBJECT_ID;

SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_full_name,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  f.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / CAST(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6))) * 100
  END AS pct_room_area_over_assignable_floor_area,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(CAST(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)), 0) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / CAST(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6))) * 100
  END AS pct_room_area_over_assignable_building_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON r.FLOOR_KEY = f.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.ORGANIZATION_KEY;

SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_full_name,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  f.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(floor_tot.total_floor_area, 0) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / floor_tot.total_floor_area) * 100
  END AS pct_room_over_total_floor_area,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(bldg_tot.total_building_area, 0) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / bldg_tot.total_building_area) * 100
  END AS pct_room_over_total_building_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    SUM(CAST(AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6))) AS total_floor_area
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY
) AS floor_tot
  ON floor_tot.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(CAST(AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6))) AS total_building_area
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) AS bldg_tot
  ON bldg_tot.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY;

SELECT
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,

  COUNT(DISTINCT so.COURSE_NUMBER) AS different_courses_taught
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at

  ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
GROUP BY
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ed.FULL_NAME
ORDER BY

SELECT
  b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  o.ORGANIZATION AS organization,
  MAX(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS highest_floor_number,
  MIN(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS lowest_floor_number,
  COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY

  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY

  b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,

SELECT
  msd.FIRST_NAME,
  msd.MIDDLE_NAME,
  msd.LAST_NAME,
  msd.FULL_NAME,
  msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  sd.SCHOOL_CODE,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT msd2.EMAIL_ADDRESS)
    FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd2
    WHERE msd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT
  ) AS TOTAL_STUDENTS_IN_SAME_DEPARTMENT,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT msd3.EMAIL_ADDRESS)
    FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd3
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd3
      ON sd3.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd3.DEPARTMENT
    WHERE sd3.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE
  ) AS TOTAL_STUDENTS_IN_SAME_SCHOOL
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin';

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    e.FULL_NAME AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    e.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS INSTRUCTOR_EMAIL,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c2.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS TOTAL_DIFFERENT_SUBJECTS_RESPONSIBLE_FOR_IN_FALL_TERMS
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
    ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
    ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2
    ON c2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2
    ON c2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE
WHERE t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA'
  AND t2.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA';

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS hr_department_name,
  MAX(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_gross_square_footage,
  SUM(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_assignable_square_footage,
  AVG(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_assignable_square_footage,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR fb.DATE_BUILT = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_BUILT, 7, 4) AS UNSIGNED)
      WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_BUILT, 1, 4) AS UNSIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS built_year
FROM BUILDINGS b
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
ORDER BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
  c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  f.LEVEL_ID AS FLOOR_LEVEL,
  a.STREET_NUMBER,
  a.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX,
  a.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
  a.STREET_NAME,
  a.STREET_SUFFIX,
  a.POST_DIRECTIONAL,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  a.POSTAL_CODE,
  dept.course_count AS TOTAL_COURSES_IN_DEPARTMENT
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.MIT_ID = c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.FAC_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
 AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
JOIN (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS course_count
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
) dept
  ON dept.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y';

SELECT
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS ATTRIBUTE_DESCRIPTION,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS UNIQUE_SUBJECTS_OFFERED
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h
  ON h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
WHERE h.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP = 'H'
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS street_address,
    fba.CITY AS city,
    fba.STATE AS state,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
    CAST(fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS gross_square_footage,
    CAST(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS assignable_square_footage,
    fl.min_level_id AS smallest_floor_level,
    fl.max_level_id AS largest_floor_level,
    rm.total_room_area AS total_room_area
FROM FAC_BUILDING fb
LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
    ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
   AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        BUILDING_KEY,
        MIN(CAST(LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS min_level_id,
        MAX(CAST(LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS max_level_id
    FROM FAC_FLOOR
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) fl
    ON fl.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        fr.BUILDING_KEY,
        SUM(CAST(fr.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_room_area
    FROM FAC_ROOMS fr
    GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
) rm
    ON rm.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY;

SELECT
  c.CATEGORY_CODE,
  c.CATEGORY_TITLE,
  c.VERSION,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undergraduate_courses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS graduate_courses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_degree_granting_courses
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
JOIN CIP c
  ON scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = c.PROGRAM_CODE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON scd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  c.CATEGORY_CODE,
  c.CATEGORY_TITLE,
  c.VERSION,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  c.CATEGORY_CODE,
  c.VERSION,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT
  lci.COURSE_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER) AS total_distinct_library_materials_on_reserve,
  MIN(CASE
        WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END) AS min_publication_year,
  MAX(CASE
        WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END) AS max_publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS total_distinct_material_statuses
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY lci.COURSE_NAME
ORDER BY lci.COURSE_NAME;

SELECT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER) AS total_different_library_reserve_materials,
  MIN(CASE WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) END) AS min_publication_year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) END) AS max_publication_year,
  SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
GROUP BY
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME;

SELECT
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE AS material_status_code,
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  lso.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, ':', lso.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS total_courses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER) AS total_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS departments_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS total_instructors
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    fba.STREET_NUMBER,
    fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX,
    fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
    fba.STREET_NAME,
    fba.STREET_SUFFIX,
    fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL,
    fba.CITY,
    fba.STATE,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE,
    sf.FLOOR,
    su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
    su.SPACE_UNIT,
    fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    susage.SPACE_USAGE
  FROM BUILDINGS b
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
    ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
   AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd
    ON sd.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
    ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_USAGE susage
    ON susage.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '36'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    FLOOR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organizations_on_building_floor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_units_on_building_floor
  FROM base
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR
)
SELECT
  b.SPACE_UNIT,
  b.FLOOR,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  CONCAT_WS(' ',
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.STREET_NUMBER), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.PRE_DIRECTIONAL), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.STREET_NAME), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.STREET_SUFFIX), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.POST_DIRECTIONAL), ''),
    CONCAT_WS(', ', NULLIF(TRIM(b.CITY), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(b.STATE), '')),
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.POSTAL_CODE), '')
  ) AS building_street_address,
  b.SPACE_USAGE,
  c.organizations_on_building_floor,
  c.space_units_on_building_floor
FROM base b
JOIN counts c
  ON c.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
 AND c.FLOOR = b.FLOOR
GROUP BY
  b.SPACE_UNIT,
  b.FLOOR,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  building_street_address,
  b.SPACE_USAGE,
  c.organizations_on_building_floor,
  c.space_units_on_building_floor
ORDER BY
  b.FLOOR,
  b.SPACE_UNIT,
  b.SPACE_USAGE;

WITH list_member_counts AS (

    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    ml.IS_HIDDEN
),
extremes AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(member_count) AS max_cnt,
    MIN(member_count) AS min_cnt
  FROM list_member_counts
)
SELECT

),
list_totals AS (

overall_total AS (

SELECT

UNION ALL

SELECT

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    scd.COURSE_LEVEL,
    c.TOTAL_UNITS,
    c.TERM_CODE,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
    c.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON c.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
    ON scd.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE
  WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
    AND (c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' OR c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
),
nums AS (
  SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
  UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25
  UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 UNION ALL SELECT 30
),
fall_tokens AS (
  SELECT
    b.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.SCHOOL_NAME, b.SUBJECT_ID, b.SUBJECT_TITLE, b.COURSE_LEVEL, b.TOTAL_UNITS,
    b.TERM_CODE, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', nums.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
  FROM base b
  JOIN nums
    ON b.FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
   AND b.FALL_INSTRUCTORS <> ''
   AND nums.n <= 1 + LENGTH(b.FALL_INSTRUCTORS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(b.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', ''))
),
spring_tokens AS (
  SELECT
    b.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.SCHOOL_NAME, b.SUBJECT_ID, b.SUBJECT_TITLE, b.COURSE_LEVEL, b.TOTAL_UNITS,
    b.TERM_CODE, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', nums.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
  FROM base b
  JOIN nums
    ON b.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
   AND b.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS <> ''
   AND nums.n <= 1 + LENGTH(b.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(b.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', ''))
),
fall_counts AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE_LEVEL, TOTAL_UNITS, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(instructor, '')) AS fall_instructors_distinct
  FROM fall_tokens
  GROUP BY
    DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE_LEVEL, TOTAL_UNITS, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION
),
spring_counts AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE_LEVEL, TOTAL_UNITS, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(instructor, '')) AS spring_instructors_distinct
  FROM spring_tokens
  GROUP BY
    DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE_LEVEL, TOTAL_UNITS, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION
)
SELECT
  b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  b.SCHOOL_NAME,
  b.SUBJECT_ID,
  b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  b.COURSE_LEVEL,
  b.TOTAL_UNITS,
  'Fall' AS offered_term,
  b.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COALESCE(fc.fall_instructors_distinct, 0) AS fall_instructors_distinct,
  COALESCE(sc.spring_instructors_distinct, 0) AS spring_instructors_distinct
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN fall_counts fc
  ON fc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = b.DEPARTMENT_NAME
 AND fc.SCHOOL_NAME = b.SCHOOL_NAME
 AND fc.SUBJECT_ID = b.SUBJECT_ID
 AND fc.SUBJECT_TITLE = b.SUBJECT_TITLE
 AND fc.COURSE_LEVEL = b.COURSE_LEVEL
 AND fc.TOTAL_UNITS = b.TOTAL_UNITS
 AND fc.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE
 AND fc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = b.TERM_DESCRIPTION
LEFT JOIN spring_counts sc
  ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = b.DEPARTMENT_NAME
 AND sc.SCHOOL_NAME = b.SCHOOL_NAME
 AND sc.SUBJECT_ID = b.SUBJECT_ID
 AND sc.SUBJECT_TITLE = b.SUBJECT_TITLE
 AND sc.COURSE_LEVEL = b.COURSE_LEVEL
 AND sc.TOTAL_UNITS = b.TOTAL_UNITS
 AND sc.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE
 AND sc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = b.TERM_DESCRIPTION
WHERE b.FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
  AND b.FALL_INSTRUCTORS <> ''

UNION ALL

SELECT
  b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  b.SCHOOL_NAME,
  b.SUBJECT_ID,
  b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  b.COURSE_LEVEL,
  b.TOTAL_UNITS,
  'Spring' AS offered_term,
  b.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COALESCE(fc.fall_instructors_distinct, 0) AS fall_instructors_distinct,
  COALESCE(sc.spring_instructors_distinct, 0) AS spring_instructors_distinct
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN fall_counts fc
  ON fc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = b.DEPARTMENT_NAME
 AND fc.SCHOOL_NAME = b.SCHOOL_NAME
 AND fc.SUBJECT_ID = b.SUBJECT_ID
 AND fc.SUBJECT_TITLE = b.SUBJECT_TITLE
 AND fc.COURSE_LEVEL = b.COURSE_LEVEL
 AND fc.TOTAL_UNITS = b.TOTAL_UNITS
 AND fc.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE
 AND fc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = b.TERM_DESCRIPTION
LEFT JOIN spring_counts sc
  ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = b.DEPARTMENT_NAME
 AND sc.SCHOOL_NAME = b.SCHOOL_NAME
 AND sc.SUBJECT_ID = b.SUBJECT_ID
 AND sc.SUBJECT_TITLE = b.SUBJECT_TITLE
 AND sc.COURSE_LEVEL = b.COURSE_LEVEL
 AND sc.TOTAL_UNITS = b.TOTAL_UNITS
 AND sc.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE
 AND sc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = b.TERM_DESCRIPTION
WHERE b.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
  AND b.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS <> ''
ORDER BY
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SUBJECT_ID,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  offered_term;

SELECT
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS hass_attribute,
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS hass_attribute_desc,
  ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AS subject_code_desc,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects,
  AVG(CAST(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS avg_units,
  SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE END) AS num_degree_granting_departments
FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
  ON ccc.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
  ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
  AND ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL
  AND ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE <> ''
GROUP BY
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC
ORDER BY
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC;

SELECT
  sos.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS department_grants_degrees,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
  SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment,
  AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER
WHERE sos.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(sos.CLUSTER_TYPE) <> ''
  AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(sd.SCHOOL_NAME) <> ''
  AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
GROUP BY
  sos.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0;

WITH mit_classes AS (
  SELECT
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    CASE
      WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 'Graduate'
      WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 'Undergraduate'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS course_level,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
  FROM FAC_BUILDING b
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so
    ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE
  LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
    ON so.COURSE_NUMBER = cd.COURSE
  WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT'
),
instructors_by_building AS (
  SELECT
    FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS unique_instructors_all_levels
  FROM mit_classes
  GROUP BY FAC_BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  mc.building_name,
  mc.course_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mc.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_courses,
  ibb.unique_instructors_all_levels AS unique_instructors_all_course_levels
FROM mit_classes mc
JOIN instructors_by_building ibb
  ON ibb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = mc.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  mc.building_name,
  mc.course_level,
  ibb.unique_instructors_all_levels
ORDER BY
  unique_courses DESC,
  mc.building_name ASC;

SELECT
  c.MEET_PLACE AS room_number,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  ba.CITY AS building_city,
  ba.STATE AS building_state,
  r.AREA AS area,
  r.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
  mu.MAJOR_USE AS room_usage,
  c.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.MEET_TIME) AS unique_meeting_times,
  SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.FAC_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY = r.MAJOR_USE_KEY
JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS ba
  ON ba.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON scd.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE c.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
  AND c.MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  c.MEET_PLACE,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  ba.CITY,
  ba.STATE,
  r.AREA,
  r.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE,
  c.TERM_CODE,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

WITH course_level AS (
  SELECT
    lci.DEPARTMENT AS department,
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY AS course_key,
    MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_items
  FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm
    ON lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
  GROUP BY
    lci.DEPARTMENT,
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
)
SELECT
  department AS department,
  COUNT(*) AS total_courses_using_library_materials,
  SUM(catalog_items) AS catalog_items_associated,
  AVG(enrollment) AS avg_enrollment_per_course
FROM course_level
GROUP BY department

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Grand Total' AS department,
  COUNT(*) AS total_courses_using_library_materials,
  SUM(catalog_items) AS catalog_items_associated,
  AVG(enrollment) AS avg_enrollment_per_course
FROM course_level;

SELECT
  dpt_name AS department_name,
  school_name,
  unique_course_materials,
  courses,
  avg_new_shelf_price,
  avg_used_shelf_price,
  total_material_records,
  distinct_material_statuses
FROM (
  SELECT
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dpt_name,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_course_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS courses,
    AVG(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
    AVG(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
    SUM(COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT, 0)) AS total_material_records,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_material_statuses
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  WHERE COALESCE(so.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL, 'N') <> 'Y'
  GROUP BY
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    NULL AS dpt_name,
    NULL AS school_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_course_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS courses,
    AVG(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
    AVG(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
    SUM(COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT, 0)) AS total_material_records,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_material_statuses
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  WHERE COALESCE(so.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL, 'N') <> 'Y'
) x
ORDER BY
  school_name IS NULL,
  school_name,
  dpt_name;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS), ''), 'No material status') AS material_status,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    CASE WHEN td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 THEN td.RECORD_COUNT ELSE 0 END AS record_count_pos,
    tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
)
SELECT
  material_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials,
  SUM(record_count_pos) AS total_records,
  SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_student_enrollment
FROM base
GROUP BY material_status

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Grand Total' AS material_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials,
  SUM(record_count_pos) AS total_records,
  SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_student_enrollment
FROM base;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS ownership_type,
    f.FLOOR AS floor_number,
    r.BUILDING_ROOM AS room_number,
    o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
    r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY,
    r.AREA AS area
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
  JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f
    ON f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG IS NOT NULL
    AND b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG <> ''
),
building_totals AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(area) AS building_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
all_totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(building_area) AS all_buildings_area
  FROM building_totals
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    3 AS sort_group,
    b.building_name,
    b.floor_number,
    b.room_number,
    b.ownership_type,
    b.organization_name,
    COUNT(b.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(b.area) AS area,
    SUM(b.area) / NULLIF(bt.building_area, 0) AS pct
  FROM base b
  JOIN building_totals bt
    ON bt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY
    b.building_name, b.floor_number, b.room_number, b.ownership_type, b.organization_name, bt.building_area
),
floor_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    2 AS sort_group,
    b.building_name,
    b.floor_number,
    NULL AS room_number,
    b.ownership_type,
    NULL AS organization_name,
    COUNT(b.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(b.area) AS area,
    SUM(b.area) / NULLIF(bt.building_area, 0) AS pct
  FROM base b
  JOIN building_totals bt
    ON bt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY
    b.building_name, b.floor_number, b.ownership_type, bt.building_area
),
building_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_group,
    b.building_name,
    NULL AS floor_number,
    NULL AS room_number,
    b.ownership_type,
    NULL AS organization_name,
    COUNT(b.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(b.area) AS area,
    SUM(b.area) / NULLIF(at.all_buildings_area, 0) AS pct
  FROM base b
  CROSS JOIN all_totals at
  GROUP BY
    b.building_name, b.ownership_type, at.all_buildings_area
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    0 AS sort_group,
    NULL AS building_name,
    NULL AS floor_number,
    NULL AS room_number,
    NULL AS ownership_type,
    NULL AS organization_name,
    COUNT(FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(area) AS area,
    1.0 AS pct
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  building_name,
  floor_number,
  room_number,
  ownership_type,
  organization_name,
  FORMAT(ROUND(num_rooms), 0) AS number_of_rooms,
  FORMAT(ROUND(area), 0) AS area,
  ROUND(pct * 100, 2) AS pct_area
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM building_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM floor_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM detail
) x
ORDER BY
  sort_group,
  building_name,
  CAST(floor_number AS UNSIGNED),
  room_number;

SELECT
  at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS financial_aid_year,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.FISCAL_PERIOD) AS fiscal_period_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tq.FY_QUARTER_CODE) AS quarter_count,
  MIN(td.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_term_date,
  MAX(td.END_DATE) AS latest_end_term_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT atp.TERM_PARAMETER) AS distinct_department_level_term_parameter_count
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
LEFT JOIN TIME_DAY td
  ON at.TERM_START_DATE = td.CALENDAR_DATE
LEFT JOIN TIME_MONTH tm
  ON td.FISCAL_PERIOD = tm.FISCAL_PERIOD
LEFT JOIN TIME_QUARTER tq
  ON tq.FISCAL_YEAR = tm.FISCAL_YEAR
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp
  ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
WHERE at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY
  at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH
addr AS (
  SELECT
    a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(a.CITY)  AS CITY,
    MAX(a.STATE) AS STATE
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  GROUP BY a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
floors AS (
  SELECT
    f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.FLOOR) AS total_floors
  FROM FCLT_FLOOR f
  GROUP BY f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
rooms AS (
  SELECT
    r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
building_rows AS (
  SELECT
    b.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    ad.CITY,
    ad.STATE,
    COALESCE(fl.total_floors, 0) AS total_floors,
    COALESCE(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) AS total_assignable_area,
    COALESCE(rm.total_rooms, 0) AS total_rooms,
    COALESCE(rm.total_organizations, 0) AS total_organizations,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    (DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.CAMPUS_SECTOR
      ORDER BY COALESCE(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) DESC
    ) - 1) AS sector_rank
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
  LEFT JOIN addr  ad ON ad.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN floors fl ON fl.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN rooms rm ON rm.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE b.CAMPUS_SECTOR IS NOT NULL
    AND b.CAMPUS_SECTOR <> ''
),
sector_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    br.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    SUM(br.total_floors) AS total_floors,
    SUM(br.total_assignable_area) AS total_assignable_area,
    NULL AS total_rooms,
    NULL AS total_organizations,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS sector_rank
  FROM building_rows br
  GROUP BY br.CAMPUS_SECTOR
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    SUM(br.total_floors) AS total_floors,
    SUM(br.total_assignable_area) AS total_assignable_area,
    NULL AS total_rooms,
    NULL AS total_organizations,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS sector_rank
  FROM building_rows br
)
SELECT
  x.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  x.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  x.CITY,
  x.STATE,
  x.total_floors,
  x.total_assignable_area,
  x.total_rooms,
  x.total_organizations,
  x.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  x.sector_rank
FROM (
  SELECT
    br.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    br.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    br.CITY,
    br.STATE,
    br.total_floors,
    br.total_assignable_area,
    br.total_rooms,
    br.total_organizations,
    br.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    br.sector_rank,
    0 AS row_type,
    br.sector_rank AS sort_rank
  FROM building_rows br

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ss.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    ss.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    ss.CITY,
    ss.STATE,
    ss.total_floors,
    ss.total_assignable_area,
    ss.total_rooms,
    ss.total_organizations,
    ss.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    ss.sector_rank,
    1 AS row_type,
    NULL AS sort_rank
  FROM sector_subtotals ss

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    gt.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    gt.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    gt.CITY,
    gt.STATE,
    gt.total_floors,
    gt.total_assignable_area,
    gt.total_rooms,
    gt.total_organizations,
    gt.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    gt.sector_rank,
    2 AS row_type,
    NULL AS sort_rank
  FROM grand_total gt
) x
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN x.row_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  x.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  x.row_type,
  x.sort_rank,
  x.BUILDING_NAME_LONG;

WITH tip_base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    tm.TITLE AS tip_material_title,
    tm.ISBN AS isbn
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
lib_by_isbn AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.CATALOG_ISBN AS isbn,
    MIN(lrmd.TERM_CODE) AS library_term_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS instructors_tied_to_isbn
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> ''
  GROUP BY lrc.CATALOG_ISBN
),
dept_library_available_counts AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS total_materials_available_in_library_for_department
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> ''
  GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
),
all_library_available_count AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS total_available_materials_across_all_departments
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> ''
)
SELECT
  tb.department_name,
  tb.tip_material_title,
  tb.isbn,
  lbi.library_term_code,
  CASE
    WHEN lbi.isbn IS NOT NULL THEN 'Available in Library'
    ELSE 'Not Available in Library'
  END AS library_reserves_availability,
  COALESCE(lbi.instructors_tied_to_isbn, 0) AS instructors_tied_to_isbn_in_library_reserves,
  COALESCE(dlac.total_materials_available_in_library_for_department, 0) AS total_materials_available_in_library_for_department,
  alac.total_available_materials_across_all_departments
FROM tip_base tb
LEFT JOIN lib_by_isbn lbi
  ON lbi.isbn = tb.isbn

WITH
tip_agg AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS tip_materials
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  GROUP BY
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
),
lib_agg AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS library_materials
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
    ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  GROUP BY
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.dept_name, l.dept_name) AS dept_name,
    COALESCE(t.material_status, l.material_status) AS material_status,
    COALESCE(t.tip_materials, 0) AS tip_materials,
    COALESCE(l.library_materials, 0) AS library_materials
  FROM tip_agg t
  LEFT JOIN lib_agg l
    ON l.dept_name = t.dept_name
   AND l.material_status = t.material_status
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    l.dept_name,
    l.material_status,
    0 AS tip_materials,
    l.library_materials
  FROM lib_agg l
  LEFT JOIN tip_agg t
    ON t.dept_name = l.dept_name
   AND t.material_status = l.material_status
  WHERE t.dept_name IS NULL
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(dept_name) = 1 THEN 'Grand Total' ELSE dept_name END AS department_name,
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(dept_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(material_status) = 1 THEN 'Subtotal'
    WHEN GROUPING(dept_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(material_status) = 1 THEN 'Grand Total'
    ELSE material_status
  END AS material_status,
  SUM(tip_materials) AS tip_material_count,
  SUM(library_materials) AS library_material_count,
  SUM(tip_materials + library_materials) AS total_material_count
FROM combined
GROUP BY dept_name, material_status WITH ROLLUP
HAVING NOT (GROUPING(dept_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(material_status) = 0)
ORDER BY
  GROUPING(dept_name),
  dept_name,
  GROUPING(material_status),
  material_status;

WITH base AS (

SELECT

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR TRIM(DATE_BUILT) = '' OR UPPER(TRIM(DATE_BUILT)) = '(NULL)' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(RIGHT(DATE_BUILT, 4) AS UNSIGNED)
    END AS built_year,
    BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_OCCUPIED IS NULL OR TRIM(DATE_OCCUPIED) = '' OR UPPER(TRIM(DATE_OCCUPIED)) = '(NULL)' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(RIGHT(DATE_OCCUPIED, 4) AS UNSIGNED)
    END AS occupied_year
  FROM FAC_BUILDING
  WHERE OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'
    AND (PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR TRIM(PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER) = '' OR UPPER(TRIM(PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER)) = '(NULL)')
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN built_year IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN built_year = LAG(built_year) OVER (ORDER BY built_year IS NULL, built_year, building_number) THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(built_year AS CHAR)
    END AS construction_start_year,
    building_number,
    COALESCE(CAST(occupied_year AS CHAR), 'UNKNOWN') AS initial_occupancy_year,
    0 AS sort_group,
    built_year AS sort_built_year
  FROM base
),
tot AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS construction_start_year,
    CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' Buildings') AS building_number,
    NULL AS initial_occupancy_year,
    1 AS sort_group,
    NULL AS sort_built_year
  FROM base
)
SELECT construction_start_year, building_number, initial_occupancy_year
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM tot
) x
ORDER BY
  sort_group,
  sort_built_year IS NULL,
  sort_built_year,
  building_number;

WITH
b_latest AS (
  SELECT b.*
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b
  JOIN (
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(FISCAL_PERIOD) AS max_period
    FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST
    WHERE SITE = 'MIT'
    GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  ) m
    ON m.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
   AND m.max_period = b.FISCAL_PERIOD
  WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT'
),
b_agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(OWNERSHIP_TYPE, ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS ownership_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(BUILDING_USE, ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS usage_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS buildings,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(EXT_GROSS_AREA, 0))) AS gross_sqft
  FROM b_latest
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(NULLIF(OWNERSHIP_TYPE, ''), 'UNKNOWN'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(BUILDING_USE, ''), 'UNKNOWN')
),
r_agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS ownership_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(b.BUILDING_USE, ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS usage_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organizations
  FROM b_latest b
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(NULLIF(b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, ''), 'UNKNOWN'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(b.BUILDING_USE, ''), 'UNKNOWN')
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    a.ownership_type,
    a.usage_type,
    a.buildings,
    a.gross_sqft,
    COALESCE(r.rooms, 0) AS rooms,
    COALESCE(r.organizations, 0) AS organizations
  FROM b_agg a
  LEFT JOIN r_agg r
    ON r.ownership_type = a.ownership_type
   AND r.usage_type = a.usage_type
),
rolluped AS (
  SELECT
    ownership_type,
    usage_type,
    SUM(buildings) AS buildings,
    SUM(gross_sqft) AS gross_sqft,
    SUM(rooms) AS rooms,
    SUM(organizations) AS organizations
  FROM base
  GROUP BY ownership_type, usage_type WITH ROLLUP
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN ownership_type IS NULL AND usage_type IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN usage_type IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN ownership_type = LAG(ownership_type) OVER (
           ORDER BY
             (ownership_type IS NULL), ownership_type,
             (usage_type IS NULL), usage_type
         )
      THEN NULL
    ELSE ownership_type
  END AS ownership_type,
  CASE
    WHEN ownership_type IS NULL AND usage_type IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN usage_type IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE usage_type
  END AS usage_type,
  buildings AS number_of_buildings,
  FORMAT(gross_sqft, 0) AS gross_square_footage,
  rooms AS number_of_rooms,
  organizations AS number_of_associated_organizations
FROM rolluped
ORDER BY
  (ownership_type IS NULL), ownership_type,
  (usage_type IS NULL), usage_type;

WITH base_buildings AS (

    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER,
    CASE

),
orgs_by_parent AS (

  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER
),
per_use AS (
  SELECT
    bb.usage_type,
    bb.BUILDING_TYPE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER) AS buildings_cnt,
    SUM(bb.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS gross_sqft,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL THEN r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY END) AS org_cnt

  WHERE bb.usage_type IS NOT NULL

  GROUP BY bb.usage_type, bb.BUILDING_TYPE
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS usage_type,
    NULL AS BUILDING_TYPE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER) AS buildings_cnt,
    SUM(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS gross_sqft,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_cnt
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b

)
SELECT

  FORMAT(ROUND(p.gross_sqft), 0) AS total_gross_sqft,

FROM per_use p

UNION ALL

SELECT
  t.usage_type AS building_use,
  t.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type,
  FORMAT(ROUND(t.buildings_cnt), 0) AS distinct_buildings,
  FORMAT(ROUND(t.gross_sqft), 0) AS total_gross_sqft,

SELECT

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN mu.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' END AS assignable_status,
    mu.DESCRIPTION AS major_use_description,
    r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY,
    r.AREA
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_MAJOR_USE mu
    ON r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY
  WHERE r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY NOT LIKE 'ZUSE%'
    AND COALESCE(mu.DESCRIPTION, '') NOT LIKE 'ZUSE%'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    assignable_status,
    major_use_description,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(AREA) AS total_area,
    AVG(AREA) AS avg_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY assignable_status, major_use_description
),
subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    assignable_status,
    NULL AS major_use_description,
    SUM(total_rooms) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    SUM(total_area) / NULLIF(SUM(total_rooms), 0) AS avg_area
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY assignable_status
),
final_rows AS (
  SELECT
    0 AS is_subtotal,
    assignable_status,
    major_use_description,
    total_rooms,
    total_area,
    avg_area
  FROM agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    1 AS is_subtotal,
    assignable_status,
    major_use_description,
    total_rooms,
    total_area,
    avg_area
  FROM subtotals
),
displayed AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN is_subtotal = 1 THEN NULL
      WHEN LAG(assignable_status) OVER (ORDER BY assignable_status, is_subtotal, major_use_description) = assignable_status
      THEN NULL
      ELSE assignable_status
    END AS assignable_status_display,
    CASE
      WHEN is_subtotal = 1 THEN NULL
      WHEN LAG(major_use_description) OVER (ORDER BY assignable_status, is_subtotal, major_use_description) = major_use_description
      THEN NULL
      ELSE major_use_description
    END AS major_use_description_display,
    total_rooms,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    assignable_status,
    is_subtotal,
    major_use_description
  FROM final_rows
)
SELECT
  assignable_status_display AS assignable_status,
  major_use_description_display AS major_use_description,
  total_rooms,
  total_area,
  avg_area
FROM displayed
ORDER BY
  assignable_status,
  is_subtotal,
  major_use_description;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ff.FLOOR_KEY,
    ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS department_name,
    COUNT(fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(CAST(fr.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_area,
    AVG(CAST(fr.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS avg_area
  FROM BUILDINGS b
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff
    ON ff.FLOOR_KEY = fr.FLOOR_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'
  GROUP BY
    ff.FLOOR_KEY,
    ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    department_name,
    room_count,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    0 AS is_subtotal,
    0 AS is_grand_total
  FROM base
),
floor_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS FLOOR_KEY,
    FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    NULL AS department_name,
    SUM(room_count) AS room_count,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    SUM(total_area) / NULLIF(SUM(room_count), 0) AS avg_area,
    1 AS is_subtotal,
    0 AS is_grand_total
  FROM base
  GROUP BY FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS FLOOR_KEY,
    NULL AS FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    NULL AS department_name,
    SUM(room_count) AS room_count,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    SUM(total_area) / NULLIF(SUM(room_count), 0) AS avg_area,
    0 AS is_subtotal,
    1 AS is_grand_total
  FROM base
),
unioned AS (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM floor_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    u.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY u.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE
      ORDER BY u.is_subtotal, u.department_name
    ) AS rn_in_floor
  FROM unioned u
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN is_subtotal = 1 OR is_grand_total = 1 THEN NULL
    WHEN rn_in_floor = 1 THEN FLOOR_KEY
    ELSE NULL
  END AS floor_key,
  CASE
    WHEN is_subtotal = 1 OR is_grand_total = 1 THEN NULL
    ELSE department_name
  END AS department_name,
  FORMAT(ROUND(room_count, 0), 0) AS number_of_rooms,
  FORMAT(ROUND(total_area, 0), 0) AS total_area,
  FORMAT(ROUND(avg_area, 0), 0) AS average_area
FROM ranked
ORDER BY
  (FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE IS NULL) ASC,
  FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ASC,
  is_grand_total ASC,
  is_subtotal ASC,
  department_name ASC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.FLOOR_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS room_cnt,
    SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_area
  FROM FAC_ROOMS r
  JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DP OF FACILITIES'
  GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY, r.FLOOR_KEY
),
addr AS (
  SELECT
    a.BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN a.POSTAL_CODE END) AS POSTAL_CODE,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN a.CITY END) AS CITY
  FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  GROUP BY a.BUILDING_KEY
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.FLOOR_KEY,
    base.room_cnt,
    base.total_area,
    (base.total_area / NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY base.BUILDING_KEY), 0)) AS avg_area_per_floor,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME,
    ad.POSTAL_CODE,
    ad.CITY
  FROM base
  JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = base.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN addr ad
    ON ad.BUILDING_KEY = base.BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN (SELECT BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR_KEY FROM base) b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = base.BUILDING_KEY AND b.FLOOR_KEY = base.FLOOR_KEY
)
SELECT
  x.BUILDING_KEY,
  x.FLOOR_KEY,
  x.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  x.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME,
  x.POSTAL_CODE,
  x.CITY,
  x.rooms_formatted AS num_rooms,
  x.total_area_formatted AS total_area,
  x.avg_area_formatted AS avg_area_per_floor
FROM (
  -- Regular floor rows
  SELECT
    d.BUILDING_KEY,
    d.FLOOR_KEY,
    d.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    d.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME,
    d.POSTAL_CODE,
    d.CITY,
    FORMAT(ROUND(d.room_cnt, 0), 0) AS rooms_formatted,
    FORMAT(ROUND(d.total_area, 0), 0) AS total_area_formatted,
    FORMAT(ROUND(d.avg_area_per_floor, 0), 0) AS avg_area_formatted,
    1 AS sort_group,
    d.BUILDING_KEY AS sort_building,
    d.FLOOR_KEY AS sort_floor
  FROM detail d

  UNION ALL

  -- Subtotals per building
  SELECT
    d.BUILDING_KEY,
    NULL AS FLOOR_KEY,
    MAX(d.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    MAX(d.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME) AS ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME,
    NULL AS POSTAL_CODE,
    NULL AS CITY,
    FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(d.room_cnt), 0), 0) AS rooms_formatted,
    FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(d.total_area), 0), 0) AS total_area_formatted,
    FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(d.total_area) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0), 0) AS avg_area_formatted,
    2 AS sort_group,
    d.BUILDING_KEY AS sort_building,
    NULL AS sort_floor
  FROM detail d
  GROUP BY d.BUILDING_KEY

  UNION ALL

  -- Grand total
  SELECT
    NULL AS BUILDING_KEY,
    NULL AS FLOOR_KEY,
    NULL AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    NULL AS ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME,
    NULL AS POSTAL_CODE,
    NULL AS CITY,
    FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(d.room_cnt), 0), 0) AS rooms_formatted,
    FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(d.total_area), 0), 0) AS total_area_formatted,
    FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(d.total_area) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0), 0) AS avg_area_formatted,
    3 AS sort_group,
    NULL AS sort_building,
    NULL AS sort_floor
  FROM detail d
) x
ORDER BY
  x.sort_group,
  x.sort_building,
  x.sort_floor;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
    lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school,
    lso.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number,
    lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
    lso.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS enrolled_students,
    lrc.CATALOG_ISBN AS catalog_isbn
  FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    department,
    school,
    course_number,
    subject_title,
    term_code,
    SUM(enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(catalog_isbn), '')) AS distinct_catalog_isbns
  FROM base
  GROUP BY
    department, school, course_number, subject_title, term_code
),
current_term_totals AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL:' AS department,
    NULL AS school,
    NULL AS course_number,
    NULL AS subject_title,
    SUM(d.total_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students,
    NULL AS term_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(b.catalog_isbn), '')) AS distinct_catalog_isbns
  FROM detail d
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp
    ON atp.TERM_CODE = d.term_code
   AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
  JOIN base b

WITH
latest_bldg AS (
  SELECT h.*
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h
  JOIN (
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(FISCAL_PERIOD) AS max_fiscal_period
    FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST
    GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  ) m
    ON m.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
   AND m.max_fiscal_period = h.FISCAL_PERIOD
),
bldg_dim AS (
  SELECT
    lb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(lb.BUILDING_TYPE) = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
      ELSE UPPER(lb.BUILDING_TYPE)
    END AS building_type_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(lb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, ''), lb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS parent_or_self_id,
    lb.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS ext_gross_area
  FROM latest_bldg lb
),
street_addr AS (
  SELECT
    fba.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_NAME, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_SUFFIX, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL, '')
    ) AS street_address,
    fba.CITY AS city,
    fba.STATE AS state,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code
  FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
  WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
),
emp_in_bldg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    ed.MIT_ID AS mit_id
  FROM FAC_ROOMS fr
  JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY
)
SELECT
  t.building_type_name AS building_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.parent_or_self_id) AS buildings_not_subdivisions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.mit_id) AS employees,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sa.street_address) AS unique_building_street_addresses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sa.city) AS unique_cities,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sa.state) AS unique_states,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sa.postal_code) AS unique_postal_codes,
  (SUM(DISTINCT t.ext_gross_area) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.mit_id), 0)) AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
FROM bldg_dim t
JOIN street_addr sa
  ON sa.building_key = t.building_key
LEFT JOIN emp_in_bldg e
  ON e.building_key = t.building_key
GROUP BY t.building_type_name

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS building_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.parent_or_self_id) AS buildings_not_subdivisions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.mit_id) AS employees,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sa.street_address) AS unique_building_street_addresses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sa.city) AS unique_cities,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sa.state) AS unique_states,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sa.postal_code) AS unique_postal_codes,
  (SUM(DISTINCT t.ext_gross_area) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.mit_id), 0)) AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
FROM bldg_dim t
JOIN street_addr sa
  ON sa.building_key = t.building_key
LEFT JOIN emp_in_bldg e
  ON e.building_key = t.building_key;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    z.ACCESS_LEVEL AS access_level,
    su2.SPACE_USAGE AS usage_type,
    fo.DLC_NAME AS space_name,
    sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS room_sqft
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
  JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z
    ON z.BUILDING_ROOM = sd.BUILDING_ROOM
   AND z.BUILDING_COMPONENT = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
  JOIN SPACE_USAGE su2
    ON su2.SPACE_USAGE = z.SPACE_USAGE
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
  JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32'
    AND z.BUILDING_COMPONENT = '32'
    AND su2.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    access_level,
    usage_type,
    space_name,
    COUNT(*) AS space_count,
    SUM(room_sqft) AS total_area,
    AVG(room_sqft) AS avg_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level, usage_type, space_name
),
usage_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    access_level,
    usage_type,
    'Subtotal' AS space_name,
    SUM(space_count) AS space_count,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    SUM(total_area) / NULLIF(SUM(space_count),0) AS avg_area
  FROM detail
  GROUP BY access_level, usage_type
),
access_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    access_level,
    'Subtotal' AS usage_type,
    'Subtotal' AS space_name,
    SUM(space_count) AS space_count,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    SUM(total_area) / NULLIF(SUM(space_count),0) AS avg_area
  FROM detail
  GROUP BY access_level
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS access_level,
    'Grand Total' AS usage_type,
    'Grand Total' AS space_name,
    SUM(space_count) AS space_count,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    SUM(total_area) / NULLIF(SUM(space_count),0) AS avg_area
  FROM detail
),
all_rows AS (
  SELECT 0 AS lvl, access_level, usage_type, space_name, space_count, total_area, avg_area FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 AS lvl, access_level, usage_type, space_name, space_count, total_area, avg_area FROM usage_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS lvl, access_level, usage_type, space_name, space_count, total_area, avg_area FROM access_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3 AS lvl, access_level, usage_type, space_name, space_count, total_area, avg_area FROM grand_total
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    lvl,
    access_level,
    usage_type,
    space_name,
    space_count,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    LAG(access_level) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN access_level = 'Grand Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        access_level,
        CASE
          WHEN lvl = 0 THEN 0
          WHEN lvl = 1 THEN 1
          WHEN lvl = 2 THEN 2
          ELSE 3
        END,
        CASE WHEN usage_type IN ('Subtotal','Grand Total') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        usage_type,
        CASE WHEN space_name IN ('Subtotal','Grand Total') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        space_name
    ) AS prev_access_level
  FROM all_rows
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN access_level = 'Grand Total' THEN access_level
    WHEN prev_access_level IS NULL OR prev_access_level <> access_level THEN access_level
    ELSE NULL
  END AS access_level,
  usage_type,
  space_name,
  FORMAT(ROUND(space_count), 0) AS number_of_spaces,
  FORMAT(ROUND(total_area), 0) AS total_area,
  FORMAT(ROUND(avg_area), 0) AS average_area
FROM ordered
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN access_level = 'Grand Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  access_level,
  CASE
    WHEN lvl = 0 THEN 0
    WHEN lvl = 1 THEN 1
    WHEN lvl = 2 THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  CASE WHEN usage_type IN ('Subtotal','Grand Total') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  usage_type,
  CASE WHEN space_name IN ('Subtotal','Grand Total') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  space_name;

WITH org_base AS (
  SELECT
    fo.ORGANIZATION_SORT AS break_group,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS organization_id,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS organization_level,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS organization_number,
    hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS hr_org_unit_title,
    mdh.HIERARCHY_TYPE AS hierarchy_type
  FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
  LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou
    ON hou.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
  LEFT JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh
    ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
  WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('139', '250')
),
employer_counts AS (
  SELECT
    hr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS hr_org_unit_title,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hr.MIT_ID) AS employer_count
  FROM HR_FACULTY_ROSTER hr
  GROUP BY hr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
),
org_detail AS (
  SELECT
    ob.break_group,
    ob.organization_id,
    ob.organization_name,
    CASE ob.organization_level
      WHEN '1' THEN ob.organization_name
      WHEN '2' THEN CONCAT('  ', ob.organization_name)
      WHEN '3' THEN CONCAT('    ', ob.organization_name)
      WHEN '4' THEN CONCAT('      ', ob.organization_name)
      WHEN '5' THEN CONCAT('        ', ob.organization_name)
      WHEN '6' THEN CONCAT('          ', ob.organization_name)
      WHEN '7' THEN CONCAT('            ', ob.organization_name)
      ELSE ob.organization_name
    END AS formatted_name,
    ob.organization_number,
    ob.organization_level,

    ob.hierarchy_type,
    CASE

        SELECT 1
        FROM HR_FACULTY_ROSTER hr
        WHERE hr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = ob.hr_org_unit_title
          AND hr.EMERITUS_STATUS IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(hr.EMERITUS_STATUS) <> ''
      ) THEN 'Emeritus'
      ELSE 'Non-Emeritus'
    END AS emeritus_flag
  FROM org_base ob
  LEFT JOIN employer_counts ec
    ON ec.hr_org_unit_title = ob.hr_org_unit_title
)
SELECT
  hierarchy_type,
  break_group,
  organization_id,
  organization_name,
  formatted_name,
  organization_number,
  organization_level,
  emeritus_flag,
  employer_count
FROM org_detail

UNION ALL

SELECT
  hierarchy_type,
  NULL AS break_group,
  NULL AS organization_id,
  'TOTAL' AS organization_name,
  'TOTAL' AS formatted_name,
  NULL AS organization_number,
  NULL AS organization_level,
  NULL AS emeritus_flag,
  SUM(employer_count) AS employer_count

GROUP BY hierarchy_type

ORDER BY

  organization_id;

WITH course_terms AS (

  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t

  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r

  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b

)
SELECT

  duration_days,
  AVG(duration_days) OVER (
