WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NON-CURRENT' END AS current_status,
    ss.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
    DATEDIFF(at.TERM_END_DATE, at.TERM_START_DATE) AS duration_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  WHERE ss.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    cluster_type,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units,
    0 AS sort_level
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status, cluster_type

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    current_status,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS cluster_type,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units,
    1 AS sort_level
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS current_status,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS cluster_type,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units,
    2 AS sort_level
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN current_status IN ('TOTAL') THEN current_status
    WHEN current_status = @prev_status THEN NULL
    ELSE current_status
  END AS current_status,
  cluster_type,
  max_duration_days,
  max_units,
  avg_duration_days,
  avg_units,
  @prev_status := current_status AS _status_for_ordering
FROM (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    CASE a.current_status WHEN 'CURRENT' THEN 0 WHEN 'NON-CURRENT' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS status_sort,
    CASE WHEN a.cluster_type = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cluster_sort
  FROM agg a
) x
CROSS JOIN (SELECT @prev_status := '') vars
ORDER BY
  status_sort,
  sort_level,
  cluster_sort,
  cluster_type;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_code,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    c.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
    CASE
      WHEN c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS IS NULL OR TRIM(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) = '' THEN 0
      ELSE 1 + (LENGTH(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')))
    END AS equiv_cnt
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
),
dept_dim AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a
    ON a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
term_dept AS (
  SELECT
    b.term_code,
    b.department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.subject_id) AS num_courses,
    AVG(b.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equiv_subjects,
    MAX(dd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name,
    MAX(dd.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS department_phone_number
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN dept_dim dd
    ON dd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = b.department_code
  GROUP BY b.term_code, b.department_name
),
term_subtotal AS (
  SELECT
    b.term_code,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.subject_id) AS num_courses,
    AVG(b.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equiv_subjects,
    NULL AS school_name,
    NULL AS department_phone_number
  FROM base b
  GROUP BY b.term_code
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS term_code,
    NULL AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.subject_id) AS num_courses,
    AVG(b.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equiv_subjects,
    NULL AS school_name,
    NULL AS department_phone_number
  FROM base b
),
unioned AS (
  SELECT
    term_code,
    department_name,
    num_courses,
    avg_equiv_subjects,
    school_name,
    department_phone_number,
    0 AS sort_group,
    0 AS sort_sub
  FROM term_dept
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    term_code,
    department_name,
    num_courses,
    avg_equiv_subjects,
    school_name,
    department_phone_number,
    1 AS sort_group,
    0 AS sort_sub
  FROM term_subtotal
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    term_code,
    department_name,
    num_courses,
    avg_equiv_subjects,
    school_name,
    department_phone_number,
    2 AS sort_group,
    0 AS sort_sub
  FROM grand_total
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN term_code IN ('TOTAL') THEN term_code
    WHEN term_code = LAG(term_code) OVER (ORDER BY (term_code = 'TOTAL') ASC, term_code, sort_group, department_name) THEN NULL
    ELSE term_code
  END AS term,
  department_name AS department,
  num_courses AS number_of_different_courses,
  avg_equiv_subjects AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
  school_name,
  department_phone_number
FROM unioned
ORDER BY
  (term_code = 'TOTAL') ASC,
  term_code,
  sort_group,
  department_name;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NOT CURRENT' END AS current_status,
    isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS session_name,
    CASE
      WHEN ss.SESSION_START_TIME IS NULL OR ss.SESSION_END_TIME IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE
        GREATEST(
          0,
          (TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')) - TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p')))
          / 86400
        )
    END AS session_days
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON d.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    session_name,
    COUNT(*) AS iap_sessions,
    SUM(session_days) AS total_iap_session_days,
    AVG(session_days) AS avg_iap_session_days
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status, session_name
),
rollup_rows AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    session_name,
    iap_sessions,
    total_iap_session_days,
    avg_iap_session_days,
    0 AS is_grand_total,
    CASE WHEN session_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_subtotal
  FROM agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    current_status,
    NULL AS session_name,
    SUM(iap_sessions),
    SUM(total_iap_session_days),
    CASE WHEN SUM(iap_sessions) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(total_iap_session_days) / SUM(iap_sessions) END,
    0 AS is_grand_total,
    1 AS is_subtotal
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY current_status
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    NULL AS current_status,
    NULL AS session_name,
    SUM(iap_sessions),
    SUM(total_iap_session_days),
    CASE WHEN SUM(iap_sessions) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(total_iap_session_days) / SUM(iap_sessions) END,
    1 AS is_grand_total,
    1 AS is_subtotal
  FROM agg
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    session_name,
    iap_sessions,
    total_iap_session_days,
    avg_iap_session_days,
    is_grand_total,
    is_subtotal,
    CASE
      WHEN is_grand_total = 1 THEN 3
      WHEN current_status = 'NOT CURRENT' THEN 1
      ELSE 2
    END AS status_sort,
    CASE
      WHEN is_grand_total = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN is_subtotal = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS subtotal_sort
  FROM rollup_rows
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN is_grand_total = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL'
    WHEN current_status IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN @prev_status = current_status THEN NULL
    ELSE current_status
  END AS current_status,
  CASE
    WHEN is_grand_total = 1 THEN NULL
    WHEN session_name IS NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
    ELSE session_name
  END AS session_name,
  iap_sessions,
  total_iap_session_days,
  avg_iap_session_days,
  @prev_status := COALESCE(current_status, @prev_status) AS _status_tracker
FROM (
  SELECT o.*
  FROM ordered o
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT @prev_status := '') vars
  ORDER BY
    status_sort,
    current_status,
    subtotal_sort,
    session_name
) x;

WITH term_subject_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    t.TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  GROUP BY
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    t.TERM_CODE
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR = LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_CODE) THEN NULL
      ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR
    END AS academic_year_display,
    TERM_CODE,
    distinct_subjects,
    0 AS sort_group,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR AS sort_year,
    TERM_CODE AS sort_term
  FROM term_subject_counts
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS academic_year_display,
    NULL AS TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects,
    1 AS sort_group,
    '9999' AS sort_year,
    'ZZZZZZ' AS sort_term
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
)
SELECT
  academic_year_display AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  TERM_CODE,
  distinct_subjects
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
) x
ORDER BY
  sort_group,
  sort_year,
  sort_term;

WITH list_sizes AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS list_size
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
student_lists AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    msd.FULL_NAME,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = sp.KRB_NAME
  WHERE msd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%'
)
SELECT
  msd.FULL_NAME AS student_name,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS total_mailing_lists,
  AVG(ls.list_size) AS avg_mailing_list_size
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN student_lists sl
  ON sl.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME
LEFT JOIN list_sizes ls
  ON ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = sl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE msd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%'
GROUP BY
  msd.FULL_NAME,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
ORDER BY
  msd.FULL_NAME;

WITH top_lists AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    COUNT(*) AS total_subscribers
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  GROUP BY
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC
  ORDER BY total_subscribers DESC
  LIMIT 100
),
student_dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS dept_student_count
  FROM top_lists tl
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON msd.FULL_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
  GROUP BY
    tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    msd.DEPARTMENT
),
ranked_depts AS (
  SELECT
    sdc.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY sdc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
      ORDER BY sdc.dept_student_count DESC, sdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    ) AS rn
  FROM student_dept_counts sdc
)
SELECT
  tl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  tl.total_subscribers,
  tl.IS_PUBLIC AS is_public,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_student_department_name,
  rd.dept_student_count AS top_student_department_student_count
FROM top_lists tl
LEFT JOIN ranked_depts rd
  ON rd.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
 AND rd.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = rd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY
  tl.total_subscribers DESC,
  tl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

WITH room_max AS (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    r.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
    r.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    MAX(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS max_area
  FROM FAC_ROOMS r
  WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY = '45'
  GROUP BY
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    r.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
    r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
),
combo_totals AS (
  SELECT
    rm.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    rm.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rm.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(rm.max_area) AS total_area
  FROM room_max rm
  GROUP BY
    rm.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    rm.MAJOR_USE_KEY
)
SELECT
  rm.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  rm.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE,
  org.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  rm.max_area AS area,
  ct.room_count,
  ct.total_area
FROM room_max rm
JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON rm.MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION org
  ON rm.ORGANIZATION_KEY = org.ORGANIZATION_KEY
JOIN combo_totals ct
  ON ct.ROOM_FULL_NAME = rm.ROOM_FULL_NAME
 AND ct.MAJOR_USE_KEY = rm.MAJOR_USE_KEY
ORDER BY rm.ROOM_FULL_NAME, mu.MAJOR_USE, rm.FAC_ROOM_KEY;

SELECT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS instructor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.COURSE_NAME) AS unique_courses_taught,
  COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_material_assignments,
  AVG(NULLIF(CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED), 0)) AS avg_publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY
  unique_courses_taught DESC,
  instructor_name;

SELECT
  rc.CATALOG_YEAR AS publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS distinct_reserved_materials,
  AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(rc.CATALOG_TITLE)) AS avg_title_length,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_statuses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ci.COURSE_NAME) AS distinct_courses
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG rc
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL md
  ON md.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS ms
  ON ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = md.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR ci
  ON ci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = md.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
GROUP BY rc.CATALOG_YEAR
ORDER BY CAST(NULLIF(rc.CATALOG_YEAR, '') AS UNSIGNED) DESC, rc.CATALOG_YEAR DESC;

SELECT
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  s.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
  COUNT(*) AS activity_count,
  AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee_per_activity
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
GROUP BY
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  s.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY
  activity_count DESC;

SELECT
  sp.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS sessions_hosted,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS unique_subjects_organized
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR sp
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL sd
  ON sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss
  ON ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY sp.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY sessions_hosted DESC, sponsor_name ASC;

SELECT
  p.PERSON_ROLE AS role,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY) AS distinct_people_count,
  AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
GROUP BY
  p.PERSON_ROLE,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
ORDER BY
  distinct_people_count DESC;

WITH building_floor_span AS (
  SELECT
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    (MAX(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) - MIN(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED))) AS floor_span
  FROM FAC_BUILDING b
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
    ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
  WHERE f.LEVEL_ID REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$'
  GROUP BY b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME
),
max_span AS (
  SELECT MAX(floor_span) AS max_floor_span
  FROM building_floor_span
)
SELECT bfs.BUILDING_NAME
FROM building_floor_span bfs
JOIN max_span ms
  ON bfs.floor_span = ms.max_floor_span;

SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.MIT_ID) AS distinct_instructors_responsible,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(e.FULL_NAME)) AS longest_instructor_name_length
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
WHERE t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU'
GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE
ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE;

SELECT
  o.OWNER AS owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS unique_mailing_lists,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS unique_members
FROM MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
  ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST l
  ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = 'LIST69.377-keeper-xenon'
  AND l.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
GROUP BY o.OWNER;

SELECT
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS distinct_courses_in_subject_catalog,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN cd.COURSE END) AS degree_granting_courses_in_subject_catalog
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
  ON cd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER
GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS student_count,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(msd.FULL_NAME)) AS longest_student_full_name_length
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
  ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
ORDER BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
